```{python}
#| include: false

# Setup
import sys
sys.path.append('src')

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from numpy.random import default_rng
from IPython.display import Markdown, display

from RandomOptimizer import RandomOptimizer
from GeneticAlgorithmOptimizer import GeneticAlgorithmOptimizer
from AntColonyOptimizer import AntColonyOptimizer
from SimulatedAnnealingOptimizer import SimulatedAnnealingOptimizer
from Sequence import Sequence

SEED = 42

COLORS = {
    'Random': '#1f77b4',           
    'Genetic Algorithm': '#ff7f0e', 
    'Simulated Annealing': '#2ca02c', 
    'Ant Colony': '#d62728'         
}

```


```{python}
#| include: false

# Runnin optimizers
NUM_RUNS = 10
NUM_STEPS = 200

results = {
    'Random': [],
    'Genetic Algorithm': [],
    'Simulated Annealing': [],
    'Ant Colony': []
}

timing_data = {
    'Random': [],
    'Genetic Algorithm': [],
    'Simulated Annealing': [],
    'Ant Colony': []
}

memory_data = {
    'Random': [],
    'Genetic Algorithm': [],
    'Simulated Annealing': [],
    'Ant Colony': []
}

for run in range(NUM_RUNS):
    run_rng = default_rng(SEED + run)
    initial_seq_1 = Sequence(Sequence.random_sequence(run_rng))
    initial_seq_2 = Sequence(Sequence.random_sequence(run_rng))
    initial_sequences = (initial_seq_1, initial_seq_2)

    # Random Optimizer
    run_rng = default_rng(SEED + run)
    result, perf = RandomOptimizer.optimize_with_performance_measurements(initial_sequences, NUM_STEPS, run_rng)
    results['Random'].append(result.cost_history)
    timing_data['Random'].append(perf.runtime_seconds)
    memory_data['Random'].append(perf.peak_memory_bytes / 1024)
    
    # Genetic Algorithm
    run_rng = default_rng(SEED + run)
    result, perf = GeneticAlgorithmOptimizer.optimize_with_performance_measurements(initial_sequences, NUM_STEPS, run_rng)
    results['Genetic Algorithm'].append(result.cost_history)
    timing_data['Genetic Algorithm'].append(perf.runtime_seconds)
    memory_data['Genetic Algorithm'].append(perf.peak_memory_bytes / 1024)
    
    # Simulated Annealing
    run_rng = default_rng(SEED + run)
    result, perf = SimulatedAnnealingOptimizer.optimize_with_performance_measurements(initial_sequences, NUM_STEPS, run_rng)

    results['Simulated Annealing'].append(result.cost_history)
    timing_data['Simulated Annealing'].append(perf.runtime_seconds)
    memory_data['Simulated Annealing'].append(perf.peak_memory_bytes / 1024)
    
    # Ant Colony
    run_rng = default_rng(SEED + run)
    result, perf = AntColonyOptimizer.optimize_with_performance_measurements(initial_sequences, NUM_STEPS, run_rng)
    results['Ant Colony'].append(result.cost_history)
    timing_data['Ant Colony'].append(perf.runtime_seconds)
    memory_data['Ant Colony'].append(perf.peak_memory_bytes / 1024)
    
```

# Cost History for each Run

```{python}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 7))

for optimizer_name, runs in results.items():
    color = COLORS[optimizer_name]
    
    for run_idx, cost_history in enumerate(runs):
        # Add label only for the first run of each optimizer
        label = optimizer_name if run_idx == 0 else None
        
        steps = range(len(cost_history))
        ax.plot(steps, cost_history, color=color, alpha=0.6, 
                linewidth=1.5, label=label)

# Formatting
ax.set_xlabel('Optimization Step', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Cost', fontsize=12)
ax.set_title('Optimizer Comparison: Cost History Over 5 Runs', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax.legend(loc='upper right', fontsize=11)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax.set_xlim(0, NUM_STEPS - 1)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

# Aggregated Cost History

```{python}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 7))

for optimizer_name, runs in results.items():
    color = COLORS[optimizer_name]
    runs_array = np.array(runs)
    
    mean_cost = np.mean(runs_array, axis=0)
    std_cost = np.std(runs_array, axis=0)
    steps = np.arange(len(mean_cost))
    
    ax.plot(steps, mean_cost, color=color, linewidth=2, label=optimizer_name)
    ax.fill_between(steps, mean_cost - std_cost, mean_cost + std_cost, 
                    color=color, alpha=0.2)

ax.set_xlabel('Optimization Step', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Cost', fontsize=12)
ax.set_title('Aggregated Cost History: Mean ± Std Deviation', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax.legend(loc='upper right', fontsize=11)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax.set_xlim(0, NUM_STEPS - 1)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

# Performance Metrics

## Time Consumption

```{python}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 6))

optimizers = list(timing_data.keys())
x = np.arange(len(optimizers))
bar_width = 0.8 / NUM_RUNS

for run_idx in range(NUM_RUNS):
    times = [timing_data[opt][run_idx] for opt in optimizers]
    offset = (run_idx - NUM_RUNS / 2 + 0.5) * bar_width
    ax.bar(x + offset, times, bar_width, color='gray', edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)

ax.set_xlabel('Optimizer', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Time (seconds)', fontsize=12)
ax.set_title('Execution Time per Run', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(optimizers, fontsize=10)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Memory Usage

```{python}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 6))

optimizers = list(memory_data.keys())
x = np.arange(len(optimizers))
bar_width = 0.8 / NUM_RUNS

for run_idx in range(NUM_RUNS):
    memory = [memory_data[opt][run_idx] for opt in optimizers]
    offset = (run_idx - NUM_RUNS / 2 + 0.5) * bar_width
    ax.bar(x + offset, memory, bar_width, color='gray', edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)

ax.set_xlabel('Optimizer', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Peak Memory (KB)', fontsize=12)
ax.set_title('Peak Memory Usage per Run', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(optimizers, fontsize=10)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Exact Average Results

```{python}
summary_rows = []

for optimizer_name in results.keys():
    avg_time = np.mean(timing_data[optimizer_name])
    avg_best_score = np.mean([np.min(cost_history) for cost_history in results[optimizer_name]])
    avg_memory = np.mean(memory_data[optimizer_name])
    summary_rows.append((optimizer_name, avg_time, avg_best_score, avg_memory))

table_md = "| Algorithm | Average Time Consumption (s) | Average Best Score | Average Memory Consumption (KB) |\n"
table_md += "|---|---:|---:|---:|\n"
for optimizer_name, avg_time, avg_best_score, avg_memory in summary_rows:
    table_md += f"| {optimizer_name} | {avg_time:.6f} | {avg_best_score:.6f} | {avg_memory:.2f} |\n"

display(Markdown(table_md))
```
